name: Leofe
source:
A young female knight who has been sleeping for many centuries, but Marnie (inadvertently) awakes her. Leofe does not know why she went to sleep, but she knows that the forest itself is plagued by a horrible curse, and she is the only one who can lift it.

[spoiler]Her real name is Lisbeth.[/spoiler]
